response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the 6+ years requirement with ~15 years of full-stack experience spanning frontend, backend, mobile, and embedded systems, and his recent roles map closely to the stack: TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and GraphQL. His current role at re:cinq includes AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, directly satisfying the AI agent development requirement, which is often the hardest criterion to fill. He also demonstrates strong engineering craftsmanship (TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development), has authored his own test runner and assertion libraries, and has a CS degree plus a track record of teaching and public speaking that signals strong communication skills. Main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js and Vitest experience and relatively light recent Kotlin/Java and PostgreSQL exposure, but these are learnable given his polyglot history and depth. Worth interviewing, with probing on framework-specific depth and architecture ownership at scale.
strengths: Hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling experience — rare and required
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, built own test frameworks
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience listed in the resume
Kotlin/Java and relational (PostgreSQL) work is dated or secondary
Heavy niche DLang focus; many overlapping roles may dilute depth
